facts.value: Students can seek support for issues such as missing the introductory week, failing exams, difficulties in individual courses, changing their program or university, creating individual study plans, orientation difficulties at the start of their studies, loneliness, mood lows, contact difficulties, or exam anxiety.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Both Bachelor and Master students in Educational Economics can contact the Educational Economics counseling service for questions regarding the content of educational economics modules, internships, study direction II, study choices, and career prospects of the Educational Economics program, as well as questions regarding Bachelor/Master theses.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: For Bachelor students in Economics and Educational Economics, the counseling service can issue a recommendation letter for an internship upon request.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: According to the Bachelor examination regulations, a practical activity (internship) of at least three months' duration is recommended.
